messages:
Nina M: Quick heads-up 1: prelaunch SEO ops for webinar landing. Need owners for: keyword mapping, JSON-LD, redirect flattening, internal anchor swaps, canonical checks. ETA EOD preferred.

Elio: I1ll take keywords + H1/H2 alignment. Will share a small prioritized list (3 primary + 5 longtails) by 2pm.

Jade (growth): I can draft the Event + WebSite JSON-LD. Send final ISO date/time and speaker full names. I1ll include offers.url for the register CTA so SERPs pick it up.

Nina M: Date locked: 2024-06-11T17:00:00Z (Tue Jun 11, 10am PT). Speakers: K. Patel, M. Ortiz. Jade, include performer.sameAs pointing to speaker pages.

ops-bot: Canary site available at https://staging.redwood.internal/canary-20240611. I1ve queued a crawl and will report redirect chains.

Elio: Note on redirects: there1s a 2-hop chain from /resources/webinar -> /webinar-old -> /webinar-launch. Recommend direct 301 /resources/webinar -> /webinar-launch. Will add nginx snippet in PR.

Jade (growth): Draft JSON-LD snippet uploaded to the PR description. Reminder: add duration (PT45M) and endDate. Also add publisher info.

Leo: I1ll run the internal-link audit tonight and output a CSV of top 15 source pages + suggested anchor phrases. Prioritize follow links from pillars.

Nina M: Meta & OG rules: H1 should include the primary keyword once, meta description must mention date + Register CTA, og:image 1200x630. Keep description ~150 chars.

Elio: Uploaded KW list: https://drive.internal/redwood/marketing/launch-kw-20240611.csv. Tagging @eng-frontend for staging preview for QA.

Jade (growth): Leaving a PR note: ensure canonical points to /webinar-launch and not the canary. Also add SearchAction in WebSite schema.

ops-bot: Crawl result: flattened redirect implemented on canary. No 4xxs. One missing rel=canonical on /blog/launch-case-study flagged.

Nina M: OK plan: PRs today -> staging smoke tomorrow AM -> deploy Wed. If anyone hits a blocker, post here. :party_parrot:
